newsitem.title: USA: Texaco La. gas line back after tanker mishap.
newsitem.headline: Texaco La. gas line back after tanker mishap.

text.p: Texaco's Bridgeline Gas said its 18-inch natural gas pipeline near Plaquemine, Louisiana, shut Friday after an oil tanker grounded in the Mississippi River, was put back in service late Friday afternoon.

"We have two 18-inch pipelines that cross the Mississippi in that area but only one is operational at a time. One line was put back in service by late afternoon Friday," a company spokesman told Reuters Monday.
The line was flowing about 180 million cubic feet per day of natural gas.
He said the company was in the process of inspecting the other line.
